_comment: Shell middleware configuration for persistent shell sessions
_workspace_root_comment: Working directory for shell commands. Use 'auto' for project directory, or an absolute/relative path (relative paths resolve from project directory when available)
_command_timeout_comment: Timeout in seconds for each command execution
_startup_timeout_comment: Timeout in seconds for shell session startup
_termination_timeout_comment: Timeout in seconds for graceful shell termination
_max_output_lines_comment: Maximum number of output lines to return (prevents overwhelming output)
_max_output_bytes_comment: Maximum output size in bytes (1MB default, prevents memory issues)
_environment_comment: Environment variables to set in shell session (optional)
_startup_commands_comment: Commands to run when shell starts (e.g., ['cd /workspace', 'source .env'])
